summary:
Architectural overhaul plan for the Textual variant table scrolling system.
Eliminates clear() table rebuilds during buffer navigation by using in-place cell updates with a fixed virtual row pool.
Loads all sample columns upfront for native horizontal scrolling without column rebuilds.
Maintains the exact split visual layout (fixed variant info on left, divider, sample matrix on right) while eliminating flickering, cursor snapback, and scroll sync lockups.
